name: finesse-term
description: The vocabulary layer for Web and mobile H5 — turns a description the user can't quite phrase into one accurate sentence they can hand straight to an Agent, and names the term they just described but couldn't call. Runs as a standing horizontal layer rather than a pipeline stage: any turn where someone says 「鼠标放上去变个色」「底下那条黑杠挡住按钮了」「弹窗底下还能滑」「看着有点土」, it finishes the actual work first and then drops the term, one plain-language explanation, and the trap that term most often falls into. 96 local entries across web · h5 · motion, zero network calls, searched by how a user would describe the symptom rather than by what the thing is called — because not knowing the name is the whole problem. Enforces three gates: every term must point at the exact words in the user's own sentence that triggered it, H5 terms ship in pairs because those traps are paired (吸底 ↔ 安全区, 弹层 ↔ 滚动锁, 输入框 ↔ 键盘顶起), and the work always ships before the vocabulary.
